tr_h_list: When an AuthRequest is received, the system shall validate it to ensure conformance to expected format and content.
When an AuthRequest with invalid format is received, the system shall return a validation error.
When an AuthRequest with missing fields is received, the system shall return a validation error.
When a token or session is checked for expiration, the system shall determine if it has expired using the isExpired() function.
When a token or session with an invalid expiration date is checked, the system shall return an error.
When a non-existent token or session is checked for expiration, the system shall return an error.
When a refresh request for an existing token or session is received, the system shall refresh it using the refresh() function.
When a refresh request for a non-existent token or session is received, the system shall return an error.
When an invalidate request for a token or session is received, the system shall invalidate it using the invalidate() function.
When an invalidate request for a non-existent token or session is received, the system shall return an error.
When user credentials are submitted, the system shall validate them to ensure they match stored values.
When invalid user credentials are submitted, the system shall return a validation error.
When a request to enable MFA for a user account is received, the system shall enable it using the enableMFA function.
When a request to enable MFA for a non-existent user account is received, the system shall return an error.
When a specified number of failed login attempts is reached, the system shall lock the user account.
When a request to lock a non-existent user account is received, the system shall return an error.
When a successful login occurs, the system shall return a LOGIN_SUCCESS event.
When an unsuccessful login occurs, the system shall return a LOGIN_FAILURE event.
When a user attempts to create an account, the system shall reject the password if it does not contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one symbol.
When a token is generated, the system shall sign it with RS256 (asymmetric) algorithm.
When a connection is established, the system shall use TLS 1.2 or higher protocol.
When a user exceeds the maximum failed login attempts, the system shall lock the account within 5 attempts.
When an account is locked, the system shall unlock it within 30 minutes.
When a session store is created, the system shall set its TTL to be aligned with the refresh token TTL.
When a user attempts to log in more than 5 times with incorrect credentials, the system shall lock the account.
When an account has been locked for 30 minutes, the system shall automatically unlock it.
When a session store TTL expires, the system shall remove the corresponding session data.
When user attempts to login, the system shall validate username and password.
When user requests password change, the system shall update user's password.
When client requests token refresh, the system shall generate new access token.
When user enables MFA, the system shall configure MFA settings.
When AuthController detects multiple login failures, the system shall lock user's account.
When user logs out, the system shall invalidate access token.
When AuthController receives AuthRequest, the system shall validate request.
When AuthService receives credentials, the system shall verify user's identity.
When system validates AuthRequest, the system shall check for valid username and password.
When system verifies user credentials, the system shall check for valid password.
When system locks account, the system shall prevent further login attempts.
When system logs out user, the system shall remove access token.
